text:
anna_sales: OrbitOne sent back their RFI this morning. Highlights: strict network isolation reqs, HSM for keys, on-prem POC preferred, and they want a feature capability matrix by EOD tomorrow. Doc: https://files.redwood.internal/rfIs/orbitone_rfi_2026.pdf

sam_se: copying the ask here. do we have a prebuilt HSM/KMS answer template?

liam_ps: we have an HSM section in the enterprise playbook but OrbitOne wants attestation + egress proofing. i'll draft specifics.

maya_security: +1. need to confirm support for customer-managed HSM (BYOK) in Private deployment and whether we provide attestation docs. I can pull the FedRAMP/KMS notes.

jack_sales_eng: POC notes: they want 2-week on-prem POC with 8 vGPU nodes, isolation from corporate network, and ability to export audit logs to their SIEM. Any blockers?

sam_se: hardware sizing looks fine. main blocker is the on-prem packaging — our private appliance has two installation flavors; need to confirm one is acceptable for their air-gapped environment.

anna_sales: @jack_sales_eng can you confirm contract quick terms? they asked for a simple MSA + short SOW for the POC and an NDA (we already have nda signed).

jack_sales_eng: yes, we can do MSA + SOW. i'll ping legal for fast-track, ETA 24h.

deploy-bot: reservation confirmed: private-poc-orbitone-2915550001 reserved 8xA100-equivalents for 2026-04-15 to 2026-04-29.

liam_ps: On the capability matrix — propose columns: Feature / Hosted API / Dedicated / Private (VPC) / Private (On-prem) / Notes. I'll start filling model support, streaming, function-calling, KV cache, quantization profiles, and security controls.

maya_security: For the questionnaire: I'll attach the KMS/HSM answers and our audit export instructions. Also note: we do not currently provide hardware attestation attestation certificates by default; we can provide the process for attestation with partner HSM vendors.

sam_se: Pricing question from them: do we charge differently for on-prem license vs Dedicated reserved capacity? they expect a line item for POC discount.

anna_sales: POC pricing: propose flat $12k for the 2-week POC (covers infra + eng support) with standard discount terms. @eli_pricing — can you confirm? (not in thread)

eli_pricing (via DM): confirmed $12k POC flat works. include optional hourly overage for support.

jack_sales_eng: I'll draft capability matrix spreadsheet and attach sample SOW + POC runbook. Need a technical reviewer for the matrix items: @sam_se and @liam_ps please review before I send.

sam_se: will review. also, add a note about graceful fallback to lower-quantized model if GPU memory constrained during POC.

liam_ps: add caching behavior: prefix caching is supported in Private but requires config to persist KV cache across restarts — note that for on-prem POC we need persistent NFS or local SSD with config snippet. Example config: ```storage:
  kv_cache:
    type: filesystem
    path: /var/redwood/kvcache
    persist: true```

maya_security: Flag: data residency — confirm logs retention window. OrbitOne wants 7 years retention for audit logs. That will need legal signoff.

anna_sales: action list: 1) jack to send draft SOW + matrix by EOD today. 2) liam & sam to review tech matrix by tomorrow morning. 3) maya to attach security appendix and KMS answers. 4) legal to confirm retention acceptability. 5) operations to prepare POC infra (deploy-bot already reserved).

sam_se: noted. I can take the model/throughput rows.

liam_ps: i'll fill deployment/ops rows and example configs.

maya_security: I'll post the security appendix as a PDF when ready.

anna_sales: thanks team — goal: reply to OrbitOne with RFI package and capability matrix by 10:00 PT tomorrow.

jack_sales_eng: on it. attaching draft filenames we'll send: orbitone_matrix_v1.xlsx, orbitone_poc_sow_draft.pdf, orbitone_security_appendix_v1.pdf

sam_se: quick Q — do we need to call them before sending? a 30-min sync could clear outstanding engineering asks.

anna_sales: good idea. i'll schedule a 30-min tech sync for tomorrow 8:30 PT. I'll drop calendar invite. :calendar: 

maya_security: FYI I might be slightly delayed tomorrow morning but will get the appendix in before the noon cut-off.

deploy-bot: infra note: please ensure hostnames in the on-prem bundle match their inventory. reach out to infra on-call if certificates fail during install.
